hero.text: Discover tuition classes, educational courses, sponsored opportunities and current promotions. Offers on our own books, resources and courses are listed separately from paid advertisements placed by other teachers and institutes.

blocks.title: Please read before contacting an advertiser
text: Advertisements on this page are paid promotional listings. RCF English provides advertising space but does not guarantee enrolment, examination results or the quality of services offered. Students and parents should verify course details directly with the advertiser before making a payment.

blocks.heading: Tuition & Course Promotions
intro: Every listing here is a paid advertisement and carries a **Sponsored** label. A listing marked **Featured** has paid for a more prominent position; it does not mean RCF English recommends it above the others.

blocks.heading: Advertise Your Class or Course
intro: Three options are available. Rates are not published here because they are reviewed from time to time, so please ask for the current figure before you plan.

items.title: You send the details
text: Send your class information and your poster using the enquiry below.

items.title: We review it
text: We check that the advertisement is educational, clear and accurate.

items.title: The fee is paid
text: The advertising fee is paid in advance of publication.

items.title: It is published
text: Your listing appears for the period you have paid for.

items.title: It ends
text: At the end of the period the listing is removed or marked expired.

blocks.heading: Paying for your listing
intro: The advertising fee is paid before the listing is published. Open the panel below for the account details.

blocks.heading: Submit an Advertisement
blocks.subject: RCF English - advertising enquiry
intro: Fill this in and it will open WhatsApp with your details written out, ready for you to send. Nothing is stored on this website and nothing is published until we have agreed it with you.

fields.name: I confirm the information above is accurate
I agree that RCF English may publish the contact details I have given

blocks.title: Sending your poster
text: The form above cannot carry an image, because this website has no server to receive one. Send your poster as a picture in the same WhatsApp conversation once the message opens, or attach it to an email to us.
Posters are shown whole and are never cropped, so wording printed on your poster will not be cut off.

items.title: Advertisements must relate to education
text: Classes, courses, workshops, tuition and educational programmes. Anything unrelated to education is declined.

items.title: Information must be truthful and current
text: Qualifications, schedules, fees and contact details are the advertiser's responsibility, and they must be accurate on the day the advertisement runs.

items.title: We may decline an advertisement
text: RCF English may reject an advertisement that is misleading, inappropriate or of poor quality. We would rather run fewer advertisements than run bad ones.

items.title: Payment comes before publication
text: The advertising fee is paid in advance. The fee pays for the listing to be displayed. It does not buy students, and it does not guarantee that anyone will enrol.

items.title: Listings end when the period ends
text: At the end of the paid period the advertisement is removed or marked expired. Renewing requires another payment and a confirmation from you.

items.title: We may remove an advertisement early
text: If a serious inaccuracy comes to light, or complaints are received, RCF English may take a listing down before its period ends.

items.title: No implied endorsement
text: An advertisement must not suggest that RCF English endorses, recommends or is associated with the advertiser. Sponsored and Featured listings are always labelled so readers can tell what they are looking at.

items.title: RCF Online Academy
items.text: The classes taught by RCF English itself, which are not advertisements.
